sentences.text: Carole King -LRB- born Carol Joan Klein , February 9 , 1942 -RRB- is an American composer and singer-songwriter .	composer	composer	singer-songwriter	singer-songwriter
She is the most successful female songwriter of the latter half of the 20th century , having written or co-written 118 pop hits on the Billboard Hot 100 between 1955 and 1999 .
King also wrote 61 hits that charted in the UK , making her the most successful female songwriter on the UK singles charts between 1952 and 2005 .

King 's career began in the 1960s when she , along with her then husband Gerry Goffin , wrote more than two dozen chart hits for numerous artists , many of which have become standards .	Gerry Goffin	Gerry Goffin
She has continued writing for other artists since then .
King 's success as a performer in her own right did not come until the 1970s , when she sang her own songs , accompanying herself on the piano , in a series of albums and concerts .

After experiencing commercial disappointment with her debut album Writer , King scored her breakthrough with the album Tapestry , which topped the U.S. album chart for 15 weeks in 1971 and remained on the charts for more than six years .	Writer	Writer (album)	Tapestry	Tapestry (album)
King has made 25 solo albums , the most successful being Tapestry , which held the record for most weeks at No. 1 by a female artist for more than 20 years .	Tapestry	Tapestry (album)

Her most recent non-compilation album was Live at the Troubadour in 2010 , a collaboration with James Taylor that reached number 4 on the charts in its first week and has sold over 600,000 copies .	James Taylor	James Taylor	Live at the Troubadour	Live at the Troubadour (Carole King and James Taylor)
Her records sales were estimated at more than 75 million copies worldwide .

She has won four Grammy Awards and was inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame and the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame for her songwriting .	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
She is the recipient of the 2013 Library of Congress Gershwin Prize for Popular Song , the first woman to be so honored .	Library of Congress	Library of Congress	Gershwin Prize	Gershwin Prize
She is also a 2015 Kennedy Center Honoree .	Kennedy Center Honoree	Kennedy Center Honors
